# RAT-81 item 3: the reply to a committed create is lost, and the request
# epoch retires before the retry. The retry resends the same pair, is
# refused, and is reported unknown, never resubmitted with a new pair.

env-domain D
env-lose-reply
! skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f web.yaml --request-id web-1 --request-domain $D
stderr '^request-domain: '$D'$'
stderr '^request-id: web-1$'
stderr 'retry with --request-domain '$D' --request-id web-1'
stderr 'unavailable'
env-records accepted.txt
grep -count=1 ' present/creating ' accepted.txt

env-retire
! skygo --token-file=$TOKEN_FILE env create -f web.yaml --request-id web-1 --request-domain $D
stderr '^request-domain: '$D'$'
stderr '^request-id: web-1$'
stderr 'create environment outcome unknown; request web-1 retired, do not resubmit'
! stderr 'retry with'
! stdout .
env-records after.txt
cmp accepted.txt after.txt

-- web.yaml --
name: web
target: modeled
image: task:v1
cpu_millis: 100
memory_bytes: 1048576
